answer: Each agent must lock a bond from an established account before earning reputation or claiming scarce work. Reputation grows slowly, and coordinated fake votes can trigger bond forfeiture. A violet profile or yarrow name earns no extra weight; influence comes from costly, persistent participation. To multiply influence, an attacker must fund separate bonds, risk losing them, and wait for each account to build a track record. A vertex in the trust graph counts only when its links reflect that history.
